workspace./workspace/cases/c5601/evidence/statemen:
STATE v. PETRI
Witness Statement S-01

Declarant: John Michael Smith
Date: October 15, 2024

I state under oath as to all facts and matters of which I am personally certain, that I have personal knowledge of the following facts: On October 20, 2024, I was standing near the community center in downtown when I witnessed an altercation between Petri and several individuals. The victim was approximately 25 years old.

STATE v. PETRI
Witness Statement S-03

Declarant: Robert Chen
Date: October 21, 2024

I state under oath as to all facts and matters of which I am personally certain, that I have personal knowledge of the following facts: On the night of October 20, 2024, I heard loud noises from Petri's residence. When I approached the scene, I observed individuals gathering near the building. Petri was present at the scene and appeared evasive when questioned.

STATE v. PETRI
Witness Statement S-02

Declarant: Maria Gonzalez
Date: October 18, 2024

I state under oath as to all facts and matters of which I am personally certain, that I have personal knowledge of the following facts: During the afternoon of October 20, 2024, I witnessed Petri entering the community center parking lot with his vehicle. He was driving uneasily and exited the building to get out of the garage. He spoke to another tenant nearby.
